mapper.insert:
insert into ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_info
article_id,
user_id,
article_title,
article_content,
article_cover,
common_id,
tag_id,
goods_id,
cat_id,
article_type,

mapper.update: update ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_info set read_num = read_num + 1, last_updated_time = NOW() where article_id=#{param.articleId}

update ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_info
like_num = like_num + 1,
like_num = like_num - 1,
where article_id = #{param.articleId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

update ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_info
star_num = star_num + 1,
star_num = star_num - 1,
where article_id = #{param.articleId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: select resource_url from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_resource where article_id = #{param} and resource_type = 1
select resource_url from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_resource where article_id = #{param} and resource_type = 2
select article_content from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_info where article_id=#{remarkId}

select a.article_id, a.user_id, a.article_content, a.read_num, a.remark_num, a.like_num, a.star_num, a.goods_id, a.common_id, a.tag_id, STR_TO_DATE(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as create_time, a.article_type, b.tag_content, c.goods_id, c.common_id, c.common_price, c.common_image, c.common_name, c.points_rate from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_info a left join goods_tag_info b on a.tag_id = b.tag_id left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common c on a.common_id = c.common_id where a.article_id = #{param.articleId}

select a.user_name as userName, b.user_avatar as userAvatar from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info a left join ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info_detail b on a.user_id=b.user_id where a.user_id = #{param}

select a.user_id, a.user_name, a.user_nickname, a.community_background, a.user_signature, b.user_avatar from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info a left join ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info_detail b on a.user_id=b.user_id where a.user_id = #{param.userId} limit 1

select distinct user_id from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info where user_state > 0
and user_name like CONCAT('%',#{param.userName},'%')

select distinct a.user_id from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_info a left join ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info b on a.user_id=b.user_id where a.audit_state = 1
and b.user_name like CONCAT('%',#{param.userName},'%')
select count(*) from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_info where user_id=#{param.userId} and audit_state = 1;
select article_id,article_content,article_cover,article_type from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_info where user_id=#{uid} and audit_state = 1 limit 3;

select oob.order_id from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor on oob.order_id = oor.order_id where oob.order_is_shop_take != 1 and oob.buyer_user_id = #{param.userId} and oob.order_status = 6 and oob.order_return_status = 0 and oob.order_refund_status = 0 and oob.order_del = 0 and (integral_goods != 0 or integral_goods is null) order by order_finished_time desc

select oog.common_id, oog.goods_id, oog.goods_image, oog.goods_name, oog.goods_price, oog.goods_class_id, oog.points_rate, oog.cash_price from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods oog where oog.order_id = #{param} and oog.order_del = 0

select a.article_id, a.article_title, a.article_cover, a.read_num, a.remark_num, a.like_num, a.star_num, a.user_id, a.article_type, b.user_name, c.user_avatar from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_info a left join ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info b on a.user_id = b.user_id left join ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info_detail c on a.user_id = c.user_id where a.article_id = #{param.articleId}
select article_title from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_info where article_id = #{param}

SELECT a.cat_id AS classId, b.cat_name AS className, count( a.cat_id ) AS count FROM goods_article_info a LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_cat b ON a.cat_id = b.cat_id WHERE a.audit_state = 1 and b.cat_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.cat_id ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

select distinct followed_user_id from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_user_follow a left join ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info b on a.followed_user_id=b.user_id where a.follow_user_id = #{param.userId,jdbcType=INTEGER}
and b.user_name like CONCAT('%',#{param.userName},'%')

select a.article_id, a.article_title, a.article_content, a.article_cover, a.read_num, a.remark_num, a.like_num, a.star_num, a.user_id, a.article_type, a.audit_state, a.audit_comment, b.user_name from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_info a inner join ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info b on a.user_id = b.user_id left join goods_tag_info c on a.tag_id = c.tag_id where a.audit_state = 1
and a.user_id in
#{followUserId}
and c.tag_content LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.queryStr},'%') or a.article_title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.queryStr},'%') or b.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.queryStr},'%')
